integrity: The exact stationary generator recurrence and positivity of the degree-two/four determinants establish the moment formulas. Numerical root values and regenerative covariance simulations are consistency checks; no independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact global count holds for one critically damped oscillator driven by two identical independent resetting Brownian walls with no thermal noise; near critical damping only existence of at least two turning points is established. No arbitrary finite-chain or heterogeneous-wall classification.
title: Exact two-turning-point kurtosis law for a critically damped oscillator driven by resetting walls
